prompt.text: Lumi, the character in the input image, in a teaching medium shot. Preserve the source's premium stylized 3D CGI finish. Lumi prepares a small gesture with her own right forearm, points beside the red flower without covering its petals, and settles naturally so its color is easy to read. The torso keeps its initial orientation; the feet remain grounded and the rear contour retains its silhouette. The eyes lead one restrained forearm presentation gesture toward the flower. Preserve exactly two wing assemblies, one on each side of the upper back; overlapping contours belong to those same wings. No torso twist, full-body rotation, back-facing turn or rear reveal; no body mass behind the overalls, striped abdomen, rear bulb, tail, stinger, extra torso or new appendage. Keep the existing wing silhouette with no large flutter. Accompany the performance with one natural blink. The teaching objects keep their count, color, shape, position and visibility. Clothing, existing accessories, lighting and the garden remain stable. The camera remains fixed. One continuous 4-second shot at a natural pace.  End with the gesture settled and a warm expression. Keep the reviewed caption space clear; no generated text or cuts.
